map.Pharmacode（Laetus 药品二进制码）用宽窄两种条形表示整数：从右往: Pharmacode (Laetus pharmaceutical binary code) encodes an integer with two bar widths: counting from the right, bar i is narrow (value 2^i) or wide (value 2×2^i); sum all to get the number. Equivalently, write (value+1) in binary, drop the highest bit, and map remaining bits left-to-right to bars (0=narrow, 1=wide). Range 3–131070: smallest code 3 is two narrow bars, largest 131070 is 16 wide bars; bar count 2–16; a fixed 1 narrow-module gap sits between adjacent bars. The code has no check digit and tolerates some print error by design.
